chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, raising it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding
the performer of Tamattu' who entered on the Day of Arafah, he said: 'His Tamattu' is complete until the Talbiyyah is cut off.'

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةُ: The Talbiyyah (the ritual declaration: 'Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk')
key_terms.مُتَمَتِّعٍ: The pilgrim performing Hajj al-Tamattu' (combining Umrah and Hajj)
key_terms.مُتْعَتُهُ: His Tamattu' (the state/act of Tamattu' Hajj)
key_terms.يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ: The Day of Arafah, the 9th of Dhu al-Hijjah

ai.seo_question: When does the validity of Hajj al-Tamattu' end according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the precise temporal boundary for the validity of Hajj al-Tamattu', asserting that the pilgrim remains in the state of Ihram until the Talbiyyah is explicitly discontinued. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the cessation of the ritual declaration as the definitive marker for ending the Hajj Ihram phase, distinguishing it from other acts of worship. It underscores the importance of verbal intent and declaration in defining the scope of ritual obligations during the pilgrimage.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding
the performer of Tumatto entering the day of Arafaat. So heasws said: ‘His Tumatto is complete up to his cutting off the Talbiyyah’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One’s al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous) is complete (if one arrives in ‘Arafat) until saying Talbiyah is stopped (at noontime on the day of ‘Arafah).”’
